transport.description: Codex App Server transport. Remote websocket transports require App Server-specific auth.

server_url.description: Backward-compatible local or remote Codex-style app server URL.

base_url.description: HTTP base URL for status/probe requests.

websocket_url.description: WebSocket URL for Codex App Server event and turn transport.

unix_socket_path.description: Local Unix socket path for the unix transport.

ws_token_file.description: Path to a Codex App Server WebSocket token file. Raw tokens must not appear in config or CLI arguments.

shared_secret_file.description: Path to a Codex App Server shared-secret file. Raw secrets must not appear in config or CLI arguments.

executable.description: Codex executable used only as the first argv element for shell-free stdio launch.

workspace_root.description: Trusted workspace root. All file and terminal operations must remain inside this root.

model.description: Model ID dynamically returned by model/list; this schema does not maintain a static model catalog.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort selected from the active model's supportedReasoningEfforts.

personality.description: Optional personality, only when the selected model reports supportsPersonality.

permission_profile.description: Experimental named permission profile. Mutually exclusive with legacy_sandbox.

experimental_api.description: Explicit opt-in for experimental App Server methods such as permission profiles and externally managed ChatGPT tokens.
